name: gage-studies
description: Review Gage R&R results and measurement tables to decide whether a measurement system is acceptable. Reads Minitab, JMP, spreadsheet or AIAG-form output, calculates crossed Gage R&R from part, operator and trial readings, and plans crossed, nested or Type 1 gage studies. Explains %Study Var, %Contribution, %Tolerance and distinct categories against the right denominator, and asks for the evidence a verdict needs. For metrologists and quality engineers working from pasted or exported data.
